cards.title: Introduction to Nuxt
cards.content:
Nuxt is an intuitive, open-source framework based on Vue.js that makes creating modern, fast, and SEO-friendly web applications effortless.

It handles server-side rendering (SSR), file-system routing, and automatic code-splitting out of the box.

options.text: Nuxt provides built-in server-side rendering and static site generation alongside client-side rendering.
Nuxt replaces Vue.js with a completely new template engine.

cards.title: File-System Routing
cards.content:
In Nuxt, routing is automatically generated based on the file structure inside the app/pages or pages directory.

pages/
--| about.vue
--| index.vue

The file about.vue automatically maps to the /about route.

content.text: To create a dynamic route for a blog post using an ID in Nuxt, the file should be named [id].vue inside the _____ directory.

cards.title: Auto-imports and Directories
cards.content:
Nuxt automatically imports components, composables, and Vue APIs so you don't have to manually import them in every file.

  • components/: Vue components
  • composables/: Vue composition functions
  • utils/: Helper functions

cards.title: Match Nuxt Directories to their Purpose

content.instructions: Order the typical steps of a Nuxt SSR page request from start to finish:

items.text: Client makes an HTTP request to the Nuxt server
Nuxt server executes server-side code and fetches data
HTML is rendered on the server and sent to the client
Client hydrates the HTML with JavaScript to make it interactive

cards.title: Summary of Nuxt Benefits
cards.content: Nuxt supercharges your Vue development by reducing boilerplate, improving SEO performance via SSR/SSG, and enforcing a clean, scalable project structure.
